scoring_justification: Recompute peak depth and fractional counts from the depth profile CSV, and check the ratio falls within the paper-reported range; no self-reported metric is trusted.

hidden_assets.purpose: Threshold values for ratio range, peak depth window, and fraction limits
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text (§3.2, Fig. 3, Fig. 8) and standard SRIM expectations
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived directly from the paper's reported numbers (ratio 200–250, peak vacancies ~200 nm, CdSe layer vacancies 0.8%, stopped ions 0.04%)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's actual claims, verified by independent Monte Carlo simulation knowledge

outputs.description: Ratio of the interaction volume of 20 keV electrons in GaN to that of 30 keV He+ ions in GaN.

total_vacancies.description: total lattice vacancies created by simulated ions in that depth bin

he_ions_remaining.description: number of implanted helium ions that stop in that depth bin

outputs.description: Depth distribution of radiation damage and implanted helium ions in a 5.2 nm CdSe layer on Al under 30 keV He+ irradiation.

steps.description: Verify that the interaction volume ratio is within the paper-reported range of 200 to 250.

Check that the peak of the total vacancy distribution lies between 150 and 250 nm, the fraction of vacancies in the CdSe layer (<5.2 nm) is below 1.5%, and the fraction of stopped He ions in that layer is below 1%.
